counting_rule: Count every real tactical CLI process invocation and every fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including timeouts, failures, and late results; no automatic retry or resume.

hard_roster_limit.counting_rule: Union of selected_low_star_operator_ids and all DEPLOY action operator_id values; retreat and redeploy count each ID once.

non_stackable: M56 is closed at CLI 1/1 and simulation 1/1. Historical balances are not transferred to M57.
objective_rule: One GPT-authored plan must first compare at least three substantively different structures, then emit and validate one executable plan with at most 8 distinct IDs; run at most one fixed full-stage simulation. Complete WIN freezes immediately.
